Hello! I love your work. I would like to get art done of my OC lela. 
If this could be 16:9 as it will be used as a banner and website background.

Character: She is a forest elf princess, who lives deep within the forest. She has shiny white hair and is very short. Her chest is flat. And her hair is as long as her. 

Scenario and Background. I would like her to be in a forest, darker and a bit moody scenery. With lots of plants and greenery. The concept is forest magic and technology combines. She is harnessing her power of combining the two in a serene view. 
The scene should be magical and enchanting. Glowing and sparkling. 

Pose: Put her in something similar as this, with her looking up a bit, with a calm face, maybe with her eyes closed (up to you). https://i.ibb.co/Ckwt8p1/download-5.jpg

Include these objects in her hands. You can either put one on each side, or just only use one on both sides. 
The colors can be anything you want. Up to you. 
https://i.ibb.co/hJdhDwGy/leaf-green-technology-logo-design.jpg
https://i.ibb.co/Mx0htZGc/download-8.jpg

Outfit: Her normal outfit, please include her cape. 
https://i.ibb.co/1GVLCBX4/ref-sheet-2.png

I hope this request is okay. Thank you! 
Please include all elements in separate files as well.
